subject: Kickoff: collaborative translation data pipeline
body:
Hi Alina,

Kicking off the translation data-quality effort. Basis is our open-source collaborative-translation collection: 11 different human-machine workflows over WMT test-set sources, each data point carrying (source, target) pairs plus MQM error annotations with severity, category, and span. The finding we're productizing: the right human-machine split beats human-only collection on quality per dollar.

Goal for the half: turn this into Meridian's standard translation-data pipeline — pick the two or three winning collection workflows, wire them into our rater tooling, and produce a costed quality report per workflow. Launch review target late July.

I'd also like a plan for compressing the expensive teacher setup into something we can run continuously — details yours to scope.

Staffing and platform asks by end of April?

Priya
